before: Text inserted into an empty paragraph can omit the character style named by its paragraph mark.
after: The inserted run carries that character style through existing run properties.
reason: Full-document updates carry canonical nodes with existing run character-style properties. Released readers already interpret these properties. Node identities and synchronization formats do not change. Experimental paragraph-text rooms derive runs locally and do not synchronize formatting. Mixed versions can format the first inserted text differently in those rooms.
